name: ops-patent-search
description: Search and retrieve patents via the EPO Open Patent Services (OPS) API. Supports CQL search with exhaustive pagination, landscape analytics, bibliographic data, paginated full-text reading, keyword search within patents, patent family lookup, legal status, and citations.
long_description: Access the global patent database directly from Claude via the EPO Open Patent Services API. Search millions of patents using CQL query syntax with tiered detail levels (summary landscape stats, compact listings, or full bibliographic data). Exhaustive retrieval via auto-pagination with automatic year-decomposition bypasses the 2000-result API cap. Read paginated claims and descriptions, search for keywords within patent full text, look up patent families across jurisdictions, check legal status (granted/lapsed/withdrawn), and trace prior art via backward citations. Designed for agentic patent research: keyword search, pagination, and progressive detail levels prevent context overflow while enabling comprehensive landscape analysis.

PATENT_CONSUMER_KEY.title: EPO OPS Consumer Key
PATENT_CONSUMER_KEY.description: Your Consumer Key from the EPO Open Patent Services developer portal (developers.epo.org). Required to authenticate API requests.

PATENT_CONSUMER_SECRET_KEY.title: EPO OPS Consumer Secret
PATENT_CONSUMER_SECRET_KEY.description: Your Consumer Secret from the EPO Open Patent Services developer portal (developers.epo.org). Required to authenticate API requests.

tools.name: search_patents
tools.description: Search the global patent database using CQL query syntax. Supports count_only, detail_level (full/compact/summary), auto_paginate with year-decomposition for >2000 results, and landscape analytics (top applicants, year distribution, classifications).

tools.name: get_patent_details
tools.description: Retrieve full details for a specific patent: title, abstract, applicants, inventors, classifications, dates, and priority claims. Supports batch mode (up to 100 patents per call).

tools.name: get_patent_claims
tools.description: Read the claims of a patent with pagination. Automatically falls back to an EP/WO family equivalent if the requested document lacks full text.

tools.name: get_patent_description
tools.description: Read the description/specification of a patent with pagination. Automatically falls back to an EP/WO family equivalent if needed.

tools.name: search_in_patent_text
tools.description: Search for keywords within the full text of a patent (claims + description). Returns matching snippets with sectionOffset for targeted reading via get_patent_claims or get_patent_description.

tools.name: get_patent_family
tools.description: Get all INPADOC patent family members across jurisdictions.

tools.name: get_patent_legal_status
tools.description: Get the legal event history for a patent with a statusSummary (granted, lapsed, oppositionFiled, spcOrPte flags, lapsedStates, activeStates for EP contracting state coverage) plus full INPADOC event list with contracting state codes, effective dates, and free text details.

tools.name: get_patent_citations
tools.description: Get backward citations (prior art references) cited within a patent, split into patent and non-patent literature.
